name: WTI Crude Oil: Price Action, Seasonality & US Production
description: Comprehensive research study on WTI crude oil covering: (1) Recent price action with 20-day and 50-day SMA overlays plus key return metrics, (2) Monthly seasonality via average returns by calendar month and a year×month heatmap highlighting historical Q2 performance, (3) US crude oil production (industrial production index, monthly) with a smoothed moving average and year-over-year change metrics.
source:
# =============================================================================
# WTI CRUDE OIL: PRICE ACTION, SEASONALITY & US PRODUCTION
# =============================================================================
# Section 1: Recent Price Action — daily WTI with 20/50-day SMA + key metrics
# Section 2: Seasonal Trends — avg return by month + year×month heatmap
# Section 3: US Crude Production — monthly index with 3-month MA + stats
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: WTI Crude Oil (CL Futures) ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# Monthly data for seasonality
src_m = market_data_source(timeframe=1M)()
cont_m = futures_continuation(timeframe=1M, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src_m.o, src_m.h, src_m.l, src_m.c, src_m.v, src_m.oi, src_m.s)
close_m = cont_m.c

# --- Moving Averages (daily) ---
sma_20 = ma(period=20)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=50)(close)

# --- Returns ---
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
monthly_ret = returns(period=1, timeframe=1M)(close_m)

# 1-month and 3-month returns for cards (~21 and ~63 trading days)
ret_1m = returns(period=21)(close)
ret_3m = returns(period=63)(close)

# --- Date Components ---
bar_ts = index()
daily_month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(bar_ts)

monthly_ts = index(timeframe=1M)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(monthly_ts)
monthly_year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(monthly_ts)

# --- US Crude Oil Production (Industrial Production Index, Monthly) ---
# Using FRED series IPG21112S: Industrial Production: Mining: Crude Oil
# Monthly, Index 2017=100, seasonally adjusted
prod = economic_indicators(series_id="IPG21112S", use_alfred=False)()
prod_val = ffill(prod.result)

# 3-month moving average to smooth production data
prod_ma3 = ma(period=3)(prod_val)

# Year-over-year change (~12 months)
prod_yoy = returns(period=12)(prod_val)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 1: RECENT PRICE ACTION
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: WTI Daily Price with 20-day and 50-day SMA
xy_lines(
    title='WTI Crude Oil: Daily Price with Moving Averages',
    category='1. Price Action',
    y_axis_label='Price ($/bbl)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day SMA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='50-Day SMA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, close, sma_20, sma_50)

# Card: Current Price, 1M Return, 3M Return
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='WTI Key Metrics',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['WTI Crude'],
        col_headers=['Last Price', '1-Month Return', '3-Month Return'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Price Action',
    order=1
)(close, ret_1m, ret_3m)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 2: SEASONAL TRENDS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 2: Average WTI Return by Calendar Month
xy_bars(
    title='Which Months Favor WTI Bulls or Bears?',
    category='2. Seasonality',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Monthly Return',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(values=daily_ret, label=daily_month)

# Chart 3: Year × Month Heatmap of WTI Monthly Returns
heatmap(
    title='WTI Monthly Returns: Year × Month Grid',
    category='2. Seasonality',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    min_color=Color.Blue,
    max_color=Color.Sky,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.1f}%',
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    timeframe=1M,
    order=1
)(x=month_num, y=monthly_year, value=monthly_ret)

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 3: US CRUDE OIL PRODUCTION
# =============================================================================

# Chart 4: US Crude Oil Production Index with 3-Month MA
xy_lines(
    title='US Crude Oil Production Index (Monthly, 2017=100)',
    category='3. US Production',
    y_axis_label='Index (2017=100)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Production Index', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='3-Month MA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, prod_val, prod_ma3)

# Card: Latest Production Reading and YoY Change
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='US Crude Production Snapshot',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Production'],
        col_headers=['Latest Index', 'YoY Change'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Blue)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. US Production',
    order=1
)(prod_val, prod_yoy)
